b1.title: Orb Cable Cuff
b1.descriptionHtml:
One twisted line, two golden orbs. An open cuff of fine twisted gold tone cable, about 4mm thick, finished at each end with a wrapped collar and a smooth round ball of about 8mm; the two balls face each other across the opening, on top of the wrist.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone, or stack it with the Kiss Knot Bangle in gold.

Details

  • Cuff: Open, approximately 6.5cm across inside, with an opening of about 1.5cm between the two balls
  • Cable: Twisted gold tone cable, approximately 4mm thick
  • Ends: A wrapped collar and a smooth round ball, approximately 8mm, at each end
  • Sold as: One cuff
  • Finish: Gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
